description: The cosine of two question embeddings, and an entailment check in both directions, as the test of a semantic cache.

config.embedding_query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

pair_view.what: Each agreed pair by itself: the scores of its golden question against its other question. A description of all agreed pairs, not a held-out result.

near_misses_above.what: The near-misses the second check would serve at this score, by name. The score was set after the first run was read, to describe it. No result is chosen by it.

whole_set.what: All agreed pairs at fixed thresholds, and at the threshold the rule would choose with all of them in view. A description: these thresholds are scored on the pairs they are read from.
